answer: Transfers out of your account are charged at 0.4% of the transfer amount, plus the network cost quoted at the time you confirm. SMS based recovery has been discontinued and is no longer offered for any account. To restore access when you no longer hold your enrolled device, submit an identity verification request containing a government issued photo ID and a short video selfie.
Disputes must be raised within 30 days of the trade date. Trades older than 30 days can no longer be disputed through the app, and the case must instead be raised as a formal complaint.
Earn rates are currently 3.1% APY for ETH, 4.4% APY for SOL and 2.2% APY for ADA. Rewards accrue daily and settle to your balance every Monday.
Transfer ceilings are set by verification tier. Tier 1 is capped at $5,000 per day, Tier 2 at $50,000 per day and Tier 3 at $250,000 per day.
Unauthorized activity must be reported from the in-app Report activity flow, which is monitored continuously. A specialist responds within 1 business day.
Funding a purchase with a linked card is charged at 2.49% of the purchase value, applied on top of the quoted spread. Card funded orders are credited instantly.
Bank transfers under $10,000 now clear the same day when they are received before 16:00 UTC on a business day. Funds show as pending until cleared and cannot be traded or withdrawn before then.
Transfers out of your account are charged at 0.4% of the transfer amount, plus the network cost quoted at the time you confirm. There is no minimum charge.
Transfer ceilings are set by verification tier. Tier 1 is capped at $5,000 per day, Tier 2 at $50,000 per day and Tier 3 at $250,000 per day.

The withdrawal fee for crypto withdrawals is 0.9% of the amount withdrawn, with a minimum charge of $1.00. Fees are displayed on the confirmation screen before you approve a withdrawal, and a failed withdrawal has its fee refunded automatically within one business day.
You may dispute a transaction within 60 days of the transaction date. To dispute a transaction, open the transaction in your history and choose Dispute this transaction.
Current staking reward rates are 4.2% APY for ETH, 5.6% APY for SOL and 3.0% APY for ADA. The rate shown on the staking screen at the moment you stake is not locked in for the duration of the stake.

A market order executes immediately at the best price currently available, so the amount you receive can differ from the amount quoted when you tapped buy. Stop orders trigger a market order once a trigger price is reached and carry the same price uncertainty as any market order.

Price alerts are configured per asset from the asset detail screen. You may set up to 20 active alerts per account.

Recurring buys can be scheduled daily, weekly, every two weeks or monthly. You may pause or cancel a recurring buy at any time from the Recurring section, and a cancellation takes effect immediately for any execution that has not already started.
Unauthenticated requests to public endpoints are limited to 100 requests per minute per IP address. Authenticated requests are limited to 1,000 requests per minute per API key.

Before an account can be closed, all balances must be withdrawn or converted, and any open orders cancelled. Certain records are retained after closure where we are legally required to keep them, and a closed account cannot be reopened, so a new application is required if you return later.

The service is available in the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area, Brazil, India, Canada and Australia. Product availability differs by region, and staking, card funding and recurring buys are not offered everywhere.
